cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Secrets Have Value
cards.instruction: Price every fact, introduction, warning, and confession as something that must be traded for equal value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'll name the coworker who reported your lateness if you name whoever reported mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then I'll trade departments. Names cost names.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Payroll. But I can introduce you to my source.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Marketing. And I'll arrange coffee with mine. Same access, same price.

mechanism: A corrects the units and scope of an information trade, valuing departments, names and access as an expert broker.
confusable: Withholding alone lacks D142's equal-value exchange; S03 should teach precise equivalence rather than just demand payment.
comparison: Workplace source access differs from siblings pricing confessions by likely punishment.
seedUse: The canonical department-for-department trade already supplies a specific professional correction; shorten stock additions.
